title: Company-wide policies and processes: access, change, data, procurement, vendors, travel, templates
author: Marco Chen
content:
Summary

This document consolidates Redwood Inference company-wide policies and standardized operational processes for: access & permissions, change management, data management, procurement & expenses, vendor management, travel policy, and commonly used internal templates. The goal is a single reference that teams can follow to remain secure, compliant, auditable, and predictable while enabling velocity.

Scope

Applies to all Redwood employees, contractors, and approved third parties who access company systems, manage data, procure goods/services on the company's behalf, or travel for business. For customer- or regulatory-specific policies (e.g., Private deployments), see the relevant project-level addenda.

Roles & responsibilities

- People Ops: policy steward, onboarding, and offboarding enforcement.
- Security: defines RBAC standards, approves privileged roles, and performs quarterly audits.
- IT/Cloud/Infra: implements entitlement automation, service accounts, and logging.
- Finance: procurement process owner, expense policy enforcement, vendor onboarding approvals.
- Legal: contract review and vendor risk acceptance.
- Team Managers: approve access, purchases within delegation limits, and travel.

1) Access & permissions

Principles:
- Least privilege by default; time-limited elevated access when necessary.
- Automated provisioning/deprovisioning tied to HR system.
- All privileged actions are logged and monitored.

Standards:
- Role definitions: use canonical role names in IAM (example: infra-admin, svc-deploy, data-analyst, console-readonly).
- Approval path: manager -> owner_team approver -> IdM (identity management) automation.
- MFA required for all console/API access.
- Passwords: use SSO + corporate SAML; no local passwords except for approved emergency accounts.

Access request procedure (numbered):
1. Submit request via Access Portal (Okta ticket) with justification and duration.
2. Manager approval within 3 business days.
3. Security/owner_team review if privileged roles requested.
4. Automated provisioning completes and creates an audit entry.
5. Access expiry triggers email 7 days before revoke; auto-revoke at end date.

Periodic review:
- Quarterly access review for privileged groups.
- Managers must certify team membership and outstanding permissions during each review.

2) Change management

When to use:
- Any changes to production services, networking configuration, schema migrations, or anything impacting customer-facing behavior.

Change categories and approval matrix:
| Change type | Examples | Approval required | Lead time |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| Standard change | Routine config updates with known impact | Team lead | 24-48h notice |
| Major change | Infra/network, rolling restart policy, DB migration | Eng manager + SRE + Security | 5 business days |
| Emergency change | P0 incident remediation | On-call lead + Eng Director (post-facto review) | ASAP |

Process (high level):
1. Create change ticket in Jira with rollout plan, backout plan, and test plan.
2. Risk assessment and impact window identified.
3. Stakeholders notified (email and status channel).
4. Approvals captured in ticket.
5. Implement in staging, run smoke tests, then implement during approved window.
6. Post-change validation and update runbook.

Change windows and freeze periods:
- Production change window: Mon-Fri 03:00-06:00 UTC (default) unless business needs dictate otherwise.
- Code freeze: release week designated by Product; exceptions require director sign-off.

Emergency changes and post-mortem:
- Emergency changes require an immediate ticket and must be followed by a documented RCA within 72 hours.

3) Data management

Classification:
- Public: safe for external publication.
- Internal: company-internal use only.
- Confidential: PII, customer data, or sensitive IP.

Handling rules:
- Confidential data must be stored in approved encrypted stores (KMS-backed) with access limited to named roles.
- No customer data in development environments unless explicitly masked or in a secure test VPC.
- Data retention: default 2 years unless regulatory or product requirements specify otherwise.

Data lifecycle table:
| Stage | Owner | Storage / Controls | Retention |
|---|---|---|---:|
| Ingest | Data Engineering | Encrypted object store, IAM policies | 90 days raw |
| Processed | Product Analytics | Access-controlled DB, query logging | 2 years |
| Archive | Compliance | Immutable storage, legal hold | As required |

Breach and incident handling:
- Follow Incident Response (security) playbook and notify Legal & Customer Success within 24 hours of suspected data exposure.

4) Procurement & expenses

Principles:
- Approvals enforce budget controls and vendor risk checks.
- Use corporate P-Card or purchase orders as appropriate.

Procurement thresholds and approval matrix:
- Up to $5,000: Manager approval.
- $5,000- $50,000: Manager + Finance.
- > $50,000: VP + Finance + Legal + Procurement committee.

Procurement checklist (numbered):
1. Confirm budget line and cost center.
2. Complete Procurement Request Form (Confluence template).
3. Obtain vendor compliance evidence (SOC2/ISO/attestations) for SaaS > $10k/yr.
4. Finance issues PO or approves P-Card charge.
5. Receive goods/services and mark as complete in the request ticket.

Expense policy highlights:
- Use company travel portal for airfare/hotel and get receipts.
- Meals capped by region per diem tables (see appendix template).
- Personal expenses are not reimbursable.

5) Vendor management

Onboarding requirements:
- Completed vendor intake form, risk questionnaire, and legal review.
- Information security assessment for vendors with access to data or systems.

Contract standards:
- Include data protection, termination, audit rights, and SLAs as applicable.
- Standard contract playbook with fallback language lives in finance-and-legal/contracts-and-legal-process.

Vendor review cadence:
- Strategic vendors: quarterly business reviews + annual risk re-assessment.
- Tactical vendors: annual review.

Offboarding:
- Revoke all credentials and confirm return/destruction of data within 5 business days of contract termination.

6) Travel policies

Booking & approvals:
- Pre-approval required for all business travel via Travel Portal; managers must confirm business purpose.
- Use corporate travel partners for preferred rates.

Safety & expenses:
- Keep receipts for all expenses. Expense submission within 30 days of trip completion.
- Company will cover reasonable lodging, economy or premium economy flights unless manager approves otherwise.

COVID / health-related guidance:
- Follow local guidance; People Ops will provide centralized updates for high-risk geographies.

7) Internal templates and examples

Included templates (Confluence links):
- Procurement Request Form (template)
- Access Request Form (template)
- Change Request / RFC template (Jira + Confluence checklist)
- Vendor Intake & Risk Questionnaire
- Travel Authorization & Expense Reimbursement form

Appendix: Example Procurement Request (table)
| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Requestor | Yes | Name and email |
| Cost center | Yes | Finance code |
| Vendor | Yes | Legal entity name |
| Estimate | Yes | Break out one-time vs recurring |
| Business justification | Yes | Link to PRD or docs |
| Attachments | No | Quotes, compliance evidence |

Exceptions & escalation

- Any exception to these policies must be documented and submitted to People Ops + Security + Finance and will be reviewed by the cross-functional Governance Board.
- Escalation path for unresolved policy disputes: Manager -> Director -> People Ops -> CEO.

Review cadence & ownership

- This consolidated policy document will be reviewed annually by People Ops with input from Security, Finance, and Legal.
- Specific modules (e.g., RBAC standards) may have a quarterly review schedule owned by the responsible team.

Change log (high level)
- 2026-03-01: Initial published version.
- 2027-09-10: Updated procurement approval thresholds and vendor onboarding requirements.
- 2028-05-01: Added change management windows and access review cadence.

End of document
